verdict.rationale: Postman's collaboration docs state that roles and permissions can be assigned to team members at the team, workspace, and element levels. Elements include collections and APIs, which covers controlling access to them. Shared internal workspaces support this collaboration model. Missing for 10: detail on the specific roles (e.g. viewer vs editor) for APIs and collections, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how granular the permission controls are.
